strengths: Consistently professional demeanor on every audited call (10/10 PROFESSIONAL)
Solid readback and right-patient verification habits (7/10 each), showing good baseline diligence when reps are actually reached

fix.behaviour: Recording outcomes/rep names not supported by the call itself
fix.quote: (absence) Form claims spoke_with_rep true with rep name and ref number, but only IVR hold messages occurred, no REP turns, 8s duration.
fix.why_it_matters: Fabricated contact details on a form create false records and compliance risk.

fix.behaviour: Logging outcomes that contradict what the rep actually said
fix.quote: Unfortunately, we don't have any record of this prescription being received.
fix.why_it_matters: Form said 'received' despite rep denial, causing patients to be misinformed downstream.

practice_line: "Before I submit this form, let me confirm: did I actually speak with a rep, and does my outcome match exactly what they told me?"

fix.behaviour: Do not log a rep name, reference, or outcome unless the call actually connected to a live representative.
fix.quote: (absence) Call never connected (0s, only IVR ringing) but form claims rep contact, name, reference, and outcome.
fix.why_it_matters: Fabricated contact data misleads downstream teams and creates compliance risk on transfer confirmations.

fix.behaviour: Place calls within allowed business hours instead of late evening (20:00 ET, 19:00 ET).
fix.why_it_matters: After-hours calls often hit IVR-only lines, wasting time and risking inaccurate call documentation.

practice_line: "I want to confirm I'm actually speaking with a representative before I note any name or reference number on this call."
strengths: Maintains a consistently professional tone across calls (9/10 passed PROFESSIONAL)
Reliably captures and reads back reference numbers when connected (7/10 on CAPTURE_REF and READBACK)

fix.behaviour: Recording form outcome as not_received despite confirming on the call that the Rx was received and filled
fix.quote: We received that prescription on August 28th, 2024, and it was already filled on August 28th, 2024.
fix.why_it_matters: Wrong outcome status can trigger unnecessary follow-up calls and inaccurate reporting.

fix.behaviour: Giving reference numbers verbally but not logging them in the reference_number field
fix.quote: I'm going to provide you with a reference number for your records. It's REF-238200.
fix.why_it_matters: Missing reference numbers make it hard to trace or verify PA status later.

practice_line: "Before I end this call, let me confirm the outcome matches what we discussed, and I'll log the reference number now so the record is accurate."
strengths: Consistently professional and courteous tone across all 10 calls (PROFESSIONAL 10/10)
Clearly states reference numbers to the person on the call, ensuring the other party has the information (e.g., REF-238200, REF-527951)

fix.behaviour: Confirming PA status/outcome verbally that doesn't match the actual form or record.
fix.why_it_matters: Stating an unverified or incorrect status risks downstream errors in patient care and billing.

fix.behaviour: Ending calls without asking about next steps (appeals) or reading back the outcome to confirm accuracy.
fix.quote: (absence) Denial given but agent never asked about appeal process or deadlines despite denial status.
fix.why_it_matters: Patients need appeal timelines, and readback prevents costly documentation errors.

practice_line: "Just to confirm before we close out - the outcome recorded is [status], with reference number [X], is that correct on your end?"
strengths: Consistently professional and courteous across all 10 calls (10/10 PROFESSIONAL).
Strong on identifying self and verifying right patient early in calls (8/10 each).

fix.behaviour: Sighing and interrupting reps when frustrated, especially on repeat calls
fix.quote: Wait, this is the third time I'm calling, just check again. I need to make sure this is actually in the system correctly.
fix.why_it_matters: Audible irritation and interruptions damage rep relationships and reflect poorly on Forus.

fix.behaviour: Letting hold times run well past the limit during transfer confirmation calls
fix.why_it_matters: Extended holds frustrate reps/patients and reduce call efficiency and TX_BLOCKERS follow-through.

practice_line: "I understand this is a follow-up call - I appreciate your help checking this again for me."
strengths: Maintains professionalism consistently across most calls (8/10 passed)
Solid patient identification and PHI minimization practices (5/10 each, on par with team baseline)
Consistently professional and courteous tone across all 10 audited calls (PROFESSIONAL 10/10)
Solid reference-number capture and readback discipline, both at 7/10, showing good habits when following the verification workflow

fix.behaviour: Volunteering full patient PHI (DOB, address, diagnosis) before the rep asks to verify anything
fix.quote: The patient is Ivy Park, date of birth December 2nd, 1961. She lives at 2948 Willow Drive in Tampa, Florida. She's being treated for atopic dermatitis and needs Dupixent 300mg per 2mL pen.
fix.why_it_matters: This is a critical, repeated PHI over-disclosure risk (6 of 10 calls) that violates minimum-necessary-information rules.

fix.behaviour: Letting holds run far past limit and calling outside allowed hours, including on an already-resolved case
fix.why_it_matters: Long holds and after-hours/redundant calls waste rep time and hurt call efficiency metrics.

practice_line: "Before I share any patient details, can you confirm you're ready to verify identifiers on your end?"

fix.behaviour: Confirmed transaction receipt was not verbally captured on most calls (TX_RECEIVED passed only 3 of 10)
fix.why_it_matters: Without confirming receipt, we can't verify the pharmacy/plan actually got the transmission

fix.behaviour: Calls placed after hours (20:00 ET) on transfer and access-check calls
fix.why_it_matters: Calling outside business hours risks reaching no one and delays patient access

practice_line: "Before I let you go, can you confirm on your end that the transmission was received and share the current PA status?"
strengths: Consistently professional tone across all 10 calls (10/10 PROFESSIONAL)
Strong patient verification discipline, hitting RIGHT_PATIENT, MIN_PHI, CAPTURE_REF, and READBACK on 8 of 10 calls each
Consistently professional throughout all 10 calls, showing courtesy and composure with every contact (10/10 on PROFESSIONAL).
Solid basics on identifying self and confirming the right patient in the majority of calls (6/10 on ID_SELF and RIGHT_PATIENT).

fix.behaviour: Confirm the transaction was received before ending calls; only 2/10 calls passed TX_RECEIVED.
fix.why_it_matters: Without confirming receipt, we risk missed authorizations and repeat outreach.

fix.behaviour: Reduce hold times; two calls exceeded limits by wide margins on transfer and PA calls.
fix.why_it_matters: Long holds frustrate reps and patients and risk dropped or abandoned calls.

practice_line: "I want to confirm you've received the transaction on your end before we wrap up this call."
